Hardwood_Burl_Noggin.description: Enveloped in the dense, interwoven fibers of ancient hardwood, the Hardwood_Burl_Noggin forms a cranium of unparalleled resilience, granting its bearer an ironclad natural armor and an unyielding constitution, while bestowing the formidable abilities to resist knockback and deliver crushing headbutts.

Giant_Acorn_Cap_Skull.description: Enveloped in the twisted bark of ancient oaks, the Giant_Acorn_Cap_Skull is a formidable helm that merges the robust protection of a natural cranium with the resilience of a fortified oak cap, granting its wearer unparalleled durability and a fearsome headbutt attack.

Woven_Vine_Crown.description: The Woven Vine Crown is a serpentine garland of supple, sentient vines that entwine around the wearer's skull, granting them an innate understanding of the natural world and enhancing their agility, while their wisdom blossoms with each passing day under its verdant embrace.

Cactus_Crown_with_Spines.description: The Cactus Crown with Spines is a fearsome cranial adornment that sprouts sharp, barbed spines from the wearer's scalp, enhancing their natural armor and strength while granting them the sinister Bleed Procc and Headbutt abilities, turning their cephalon into a deadly weapon.

Hollow_Gourd_Cranium.description: Enveloped in a shell of twisted, vine-like tendrils, the Hollow Gourd Cranium pulsates with an eerie green glow, its interior a labyrinth of interconnected chambers that amplify the user's wisdom and charisma, granting them the ability to unleash devastating sonic attacks and resist the effects of sonic magic.

Petrified_Wood_Skull.description: The Petrified_Wood_Skull, a relic of ancient, petrified flora, encases the wearer's head in an armor of dense, unyielding wood, granting a formidable natural shield against physical onslaughts while imparting a sluggish heaviness that hinders swift movements.

Fleshy_Flytrap_Hood.description: This grotesque cranial appendage sprouts from the forehead, a dark, pulsating mass of fleshy vines that coalesce into a maw filled with razor-sharp teeth, granting the bearer a fearsome bite and bolstering their physical might and resilience.

Bioluminescent_Mushroom_Cap.description: Enveloped in an ethereal glow, the Bioluminescent Mushroom Cap is a living symbiosis of arcane energy and fungal resilience, enhancing one's wisdom and charisma while granting the abilities to emit radiant light and detect magical auras.

Sun_Seeking_Sunflower_Crown.description: The Sun-Seeking Sunflower Crown is a vibrant, almost sentient floral structure that coils around the cranium, its petals perpetually tilting towards the light, enhancing the wearer's perception and charisma while granting them the skills Alert and Light.

Thick_Kelp_Mat_Cranium.description: The Thick Kelp Mat Cranium is a resilient, plant-based cranial armor that intertwines thick, protective layers of kelp around the head, granting the wearer superior natural armor and a heightened constitution, while also bestowing the abilities of water breathing and blocking attacks with seaweed tendrils.
